title: Mad Max: Fury Road
synopsis: A war rig, five wives, and a long road across a desert that goes both ways.

nodes.text: Hooks pull you down into a place that calls itself the Citadel. The road still runs toward Blood Bag. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Fight the chains” and choosing “Go limp.”

choices.consequence: You commit to fight the chains. It buys momentum toward Blood Bag and spends the last protection hesitation gave you.
You go limp. The route to Blood Bag opens fast, while the margin for a second attempt disappears.

nodes.text: Hose in your arm, a mask on your face, a War Boy painted white above you. You are unlikely to keep all three. Both choices lead to Furiosa Turns East, but “Bide” arrives there with a different cost than “Bite.”

choices.consequence: You choose to bide. By Furiosa Turns East, everyone watching will understand exactly which risk you accepted.
You bite. The route to Furiosa Turns East opens fast, while the margin for a second attempt disappears.

nodes.text: Furiosa rises on the platform with the wives, breathing through a tube of your blood. You are unlikely to keep all three. “Step back into the crowd” opens the route to Water for All. “Ride up with her” changes the terms and carries you toward Back to the Road. A third choice, “Take the third path,” keeps Witnessed in play.

choices.consequence: You step back into the crowd. The route to Water for All opens fast, while the margin for a second attempt disappears.
You choose to ride up with her. By Back to the Road, everyone watching will understand exactly which risk you accepted.
Some endings reveal themselves last. You choose to take the third path. By Witnessed, everyone watching will understand exactly which risk you accepted.

nodes.text: The wheels lock, the gates open, and the Citadel learns it was always two days from kindness. The road into Water for All began with “Step back into the crowd” in Lift Up; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

You slip down through the crowd before anyone can name you. The road goes both ways and you are not done being driven. You are unlikely to keep all three. The road into Back to the Road began with “Ride up with her” in Lift Up; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

Nux's grin in the rearview, half a second before chrome. You will see it for the rest of your long, accidental life. The road into Witnessed began with “Take the third path” in Lift Up; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
